description: At-a-glance traffic overview with L4/application pies. Scope: All / East-West / North-South.

targets.query:
SELECT sum(bytes * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate)) AS total_bytes
FROM $table
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND (
    '$scope' = 'all'
    OR (
      '$scope' = 'ew'
      AND etype = 2048
      AND (
        isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '10.0.0.0/8')
        OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '172.16.0.0/12')
        OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '192.168.0.0/16')
        OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '100.64.0.0/10')
      )
      AND (
        isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '10.0.0.0/8')
        OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '172.16.0.0/12')
        OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '192.168.0.0/16')
        OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '100.64.0.0/10')
      )
    )
    OR (
      '$scope' = 'ns'
      AND etype = 2048
      AND (
        (
          (isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '10.0.0.0/8')
            OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '172.16.0.0/12')
            OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '192.168.0.0/16')
            OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '100.64.0.0/10'))
          AND NOT (
            isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '10.0.0.0/8')
            OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '172.16.0.0/12')
            OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '192.168.0.0/16')
            OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '100.64.0.0/10'))
        )
        OR (
          NOT (
            isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '10.0.0.0/8')
            OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '172.16.0.0/12')
            OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '192.168.0.0/16')
            OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '100.64.0.0/10'))
          AND (
            isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '10.0.0.0/8')
            OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '172.16.0.0/12')
            OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '192.168.0.0/16')
            OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '100.64.0.0/10'))
        )
      )
    )
  )

SELECT t, sum(sumbytes) AS sumbytes
FROM (
  SELECT $timeSeries AS t, sum(bytes * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate)) * 8 / $interval AS sumbytes
  FROM $table
  WHERE $timeFilter
    AND (
      '$scope' = 'all'
      OR (
        '$scope' = 'ew'
        AND etype = 2048
        AND (
          isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '10.0.0.0/8')
          OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '172.16.0.0/12')
          OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '192.168.0.0/16')
          OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '100.64.0.0/10')
        )
        AND (
          isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '10.0.0.0/8')
          OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '172.16.0.0/12')
          OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '192.168.0.0/16')
          OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '100.64.0.0/10')
        )
      )
      OR (
        '$scope' = 'ns'
        AND etype = 2048
        AND (
          (
            (isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '10.0.0.0/8')
              OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '172.16.0.0/12')
              OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '192.168.0.0/16')
              OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '100.64.0.0/10'))
            AND NOT (
              isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '10.0.0.0/8')
              OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '172.16.0.0/12')
              OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '192.168.0.0/16')
              OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '100.64.0.0/10'))
          )
          OR (
            NOT (
              isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '10.0.0.0/8')
              OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '172.16.0.0/12')
              OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '192.168.0.0/16')
              OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '100.64.0.0/10'))
            AND (
              isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '10.0.0.0/8')
              OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '172.16.0.0/12')
              OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '192.168.0.0/16')
              OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '100.64.0.0/10'))
          )
        )
      )
    )
  GROUP BY t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT toInt64(intDiv($from + number * $interval, $interval) * $interval * 1000) AS t, 0 AS sumbytes
  FROM numbers(intDiv($to - $from, $interval))
)
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panels.description: Traffic rate (bits per second). Totals in tables remain in bytes.

targets.query:
SELECT
  multiIf(
    proto = 6, 'TCP',
    proto = 17, 'UDP',
    proto = 1, 'ICMP',
    proto = 58, 'ICMPv6',
    proto = 47, 'GRE',
    ifNull(nullIf(dictGetString('dictionaries.protocols', 'name', toUInt64(proto)), ''), concat('Other(', toString(proto), ')'))
  ) AS protocol,
  sum(bytes * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate)) AS traffic
FROM $table
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND (
    '$scope' = 'all'
    OR (
      '$scope' = 'ew'
      AND etype = 2048
      AND (
        isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '10.0.0.0/8')

          NOT (
            isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '10.0.0.0/8')
            OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '172.16.0.0/12')
            OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '192.168.0.0/16')
            OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '100.64.0.0/10'))
          AND (
            isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '10.0.0.0/8')
            OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '172.16.0.0/12')
            OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '192.168.0.0/16')

  if(etype = 2048, IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), IPv6NumToString(src_addr)) AS src_ip,
  sum(bytes * if(sampling_rate = 0, 1, sampling_rate)) AS traffic
FROM $table
WHERE $timeFilter
  AND (
    '$scope' = 'all'
    OR (
      '$scope' = 'ew'
      AND etype = 2048
      AND (
        isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '10.0.0.0/8')
        OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '172.16.0.0/12')
        OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '192.168.0.0/16')
        OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '100.64.0.0/10')
      )
      AND (
        isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '10.0.0.0/8')
        OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '172.16.0.0/12')
        OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '192.168.0.0/16')
        OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '100.64.0.0/10')
      )
    )
    OR (
      '$scope' = 'ns'
      AND etype = 2048
      AND (
        (
          (isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '10.0.0.0/8')
            OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '172.16.0.0/12')
            OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '192.168.0.0/16')
            OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '100.64.0.0/10'))
          AND NOT (
            isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '10.0.0.0/8')
            OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '172.16.0.0/12')
            OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '192.168.0.0/16')
            OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '100.64.0.0/10'))
        )
        OR (
          NOT (
            isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '10.0.0.0/8')
            OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '172.16.0.0/12')
            OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '192.168.0.0/16')
            OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '100.64.0.0/10'))
          AND (
            isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '10.0.0.0/8')
            OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '172.16.0.0/12')
            OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '192.168.0.0/16')
            OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(dst_addr), 13, 4))), '100.64.0.0/10'))
        )
      )
    )
  )
  AND (
    '$scope' = 'all'
    OR (
      '$scope' = 'ew'
      AND (
        isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '10.0.0.0/8')
        OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '172.16.0.0/12')
        OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '192.168.0.0/16')
        OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '100.64.0.0/10')
      )
    )
    OR (
      '$scope' = 'ns'
      AND etype = 2048
      AND (
        isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '10.0.0.0/8')
        OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '172.16.0.0/12')
        OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '192.168.0.0/16')
        OR isIPAddressInRange(IPv4NumToString(reinterpretAsUInt32(substring(reverse(src_addr), 13, 4))), '100.64.0.0/10')
      )
    )
  )
GROUP BY src_ip
ORDER BY traffic DESC
LIMIT toUInt64OrZero('$topn')
